title: Native bootstrap and completed single-attempt execution capture v5
description: Closed ten-field local capture, one JSON line plus one LF at most 1572864 bytes. Written only after exact workload/guardian reaps, separate empty-leaf observations and complete bounded output accounting. Original proof bytes are retained, not renewed. No capture follows an uncertain execution/cleanup; a nonzero workload exit can produce a terminal capture but the CLI still fails. Output is data, never action or restart permission. V1-v4 profiles cannot be relabeled as v5.
